comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Found at Ustyurt Plateau landing point; a minimum of R5 Recognition is required. Seems to be located "between the Stacked Boulders and Upturned Boulder" landmarks in the daytime; Sunny/Cloudy conditions appear to be fine but it will not show up if it's raining.

Source: gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/QuestDB/action/QuestShow?id=5831
